interpretation: The exclusive transaction lock repaired the v1 duplicate-write failure, but temperature zero plus a fixed vLLM request seed did not guarantee exact policy trajectory replay on a new task. Because the v2 contract required exact no-memory action replay, this realization is a protocol/support stop. It has zero authority on the evaluation-aliasing hypothesis.
repair_direction: Use a content-addressed response cache keyed by the full model request so identical policy prompts map to the same first observed model response. The cache does not hide environment drift: any change in observation, history, or admissible-command text changes the request hash and creates a cache miss.

Do not open the v2 sealed Stage B.
